source.title: What To Wear With Cargo Pants (The Modest Man)

tips.text: Slim cargo pants with few pockets read dressier; relaxed or baggy cuts with many pockets keep the look casual.
tips.why: Fit and pockets set how formal cargos look.

tips.text: Black cargos suit high-low dressing: with a polo, a button-down or a sport coat they work for smart casual nights out.
Olive, khaki, grey and brown cargos keep a military feel; pair them with workwear shirts, overshirts and boots.
tips.why: The classic utility look hangs together.

tips.text: Cargo pants are never formal: keep them away from suits, dress shoes and evening dress codes.
tips.why: Cargos stay casual whatever you pair them with.

tips.text: Avoid cinched or elastic hems on cargos with leather boots or dress shoes; they make them look like joggers.
tips.why: Cinched hems clash with leather footwear.

tips.text: Baggy cargos look tidy with a single break at the shoe and a higher waist; wear them with a tee or crewneck and boots or sneakers.
tips.why: Clean lines keep loose cargos intentional.

outfits.outfit: shirt white casual +button-down, trousers olive slim casual +cargo, sneakers white minimal
